{{Quote|The ''Twilight Jumper'' is a fine example of your basic Ghtroc Industries class 720 freighter.|Fiz Cor'gril on the ''Twilight Jumper''.|<ref name="AJ9" />}}
'''''Twilight Jumper''''' was a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[720 light freighter/Legends|720 light freighter]] which was for sale by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] used space [[Transport/Legends|transport]] salesman [[Fiz Cor'gril]].<ref name="AJ9" />

==Characteristics==
The ''Twilight Jumper''{{'s}} specifications were left basically the same of the stock model. However, the constant abuse the ship had suffered over the years made the engines consume [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] around fifty percent faster. Consumables had to be refilled after only a week and the hull was prone to failure.<ref name="AJ9" />

==History==
At one point in history, the ship's hull was so badly damaged, it had to be completely replaced, but was still slightly compromised. All the other systems had been so badly damaged and repaired that the ship was on the verge of breaking apart. This abuse was clearly visible just by looking at the hull.<ref name="AJ9" />

The ''Twilight Jumper'' was put on sale at ''[[Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships]]'' for 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="AJ9" />
